svg.title: StudioForge architecture
svg.desc: Client machines (any OpenAI client, OpenClaw with sfctl, a browser) talk to the StudioForge gateway on the host machine, which plans VRAM and supervises one llama-server process per loaded model; a watchdog recovers the gateway.
svg.text: One machine with the GPUs serves every client the way a hosted API would. Nothing installs anywhere else.
optional — a laptop on the LAN, the agent's box,
the GPUs and the model library — the only machine that installs anything
web UI · on Windows, a system tray too
GGUF files on disk — indexed in place,
Ports are defaults · see README → Ports
